policies.title: New Zealand ordinary passports: Jordan arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Jordan Tourism Board's live nationality table says a New Zealand passport holder can obtain a visa on arrival.
conditions: The table identifies New Zealand as applicable and states that the visa is obtained upon arrival for 40 JOD.
Entry point, passport validity, work, residence, special documents, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: New Zealand ordinary passports: Panama visa-free visits
policies.summary: Panama's official Embassy lists New Zealand among nationalities requiring no tourist visa.
conditions: The published ordinary nationality waiver permits a tourist stay of up to three months.
Work, residence, special documents, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: New Zealand ordinary passports: Paraguay temporary visa-free tourism
policies.summary: Paraguay Foreign Ministry says Law 7314/2024 eliminates the tourist-visa requirement for New Zealand citizens for stays up to 90 days through 13 August 2027.
conditions: This statutory temporary waiver is limited to tourism stays of no more than 90 days and expires on 13 August 2027.

The same consular page retains an older arrival-visa notice, but the later enacted Law 7314/2024 expressly removes the tourist-visa requirement for the stated period. Work, residence, special documents, carrier and final admission remain separate.

conflicts.explanation: Paraguay Foreign Ministry says enacted Law 7314/2024 eliminates the tourist-visa requirement for New Zealand citizens for stays up to 90 days through 13 August 2027; the older arrival-visa notice does not override the later waiver.
